 On the Line | Daily Iowan staff picks a slate of Week 11 college football games
 No. 15 Iowa hosts Purdue, while potential playoff-deciding matchups headline this week’s slate. 
 Jackson Miller , Sports Editor 
 • 
 November 12, 2026 
 Gabby Drees The Iowa Hawkeyes celebrate after a football game between the #19 Iowa Hawkeyes and the Northwestern Wildcats at Ryan Field in Evanston, Ill., on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The Hawkeyes defeated the Wildcats, 24-10. (Gabby Drees/The Daily Iowan) 
 Purdue @ No. 15 Iowa 
 Jackson Miller, Sports Editor (32-22): Iowa – 2021 Iowa vs. Purdue never happened. 
 Jonah Frey, Assistant Sports Editor (35-19): Iowa – It’s not 2021 anymore. 
 Samantha DeFily, Creative Director (39-16): Iowa – If only Kevin Kane could see Phil Parker in action one last time. 
 Collin Carrithers, DITV Sports Director (39-16): Iowa – Don’t even bring it up. Just don’t. 
 Elise Gan, DITV Sports Director (35-19): Iowa – If Iowa loses, just bomb the football program.  
 John Bohnenkamp, Sports Writing Coach (37-17): Iowa – A few years ago, this is an 11 a.m. BTN game. 
 Jason Brummond, Publisher (37-17): Iowa – Hawks’ playoff hopes are alive and thriving.  
 No. 18 USC @ No. 9 Indiana 
 Jackson Miller, Sports Editor (32-22): Indiana – I love Curt Cignetti. 
 Jonah Frey, Assistant Sports Editor (35-19): I ndiana – Stoppable force versus movable object. 
 Samantha DeFily, Creative Director (39-16): Indiana – Lincoln Riley is about to be fired before Luke Fickell is. 
 Collin Carrithers, DITV Sports Director (39-16): Indiana – Which red is better? 
 Elise Gan, DITV Sports Director (35-19): Indiana – USC needs a win to stay alive. 
 John Bohnenkamp, Sports Writing Coach (37-17): Indiana – Hoosiers will stay in the Big Ten title hunt. 
 Jason Brummond, Publisher (37-17): Indiana – Hoosiers remain the Big Ten’s best. 
 No. 6 Texas @ No. 21 LSU 
 Jackson Miller, Sports Editor (32-22): Texas – I don’t even know anymore. 
 Jonah Frey, Assistant Sports Editor (35-19): LSU – An absolute must-win for both teams. 
 Samantha DeFily, Creative Director (39-16): LSU – I can not stand the SEC; it’s actually painful to watch at this point. 
 Collin Carrithers, DITV Sports Director (39-16): LSU – I puke every single time I have to pick one of these vile SEC teams. 
 Elise Gan, DITV Sports Director (35-19): LSU – Texas has the opportunity to do the funniest thing ever… but I don’t think they will. 
 John Bohnenkamp, Sports Writing Coach (37-17): LSU – A battle of two unlikeable, underachieving coaches. 
 Jason Brummond, Publisher (37-17): Texas – The Lane Train is off the tracks. 
 No. 2 Utah @ No. 23 Arizona 
 Jackson Miller, Sports Editor (32-22): Utah – The Utes are an absolute wagon. 
 Jonah Frey, Assistant Sports Editor (35-19): Arizona – Fifita is going to will the Wildcats to a field rush. 
 Samantha DeFily, Creative Director (39-16): Utah – You know what, I’m really rooting for the Utes now.  
 Collin Carrithers, DITV Sports Director (39-16): Utah – Just a flat-out wagon. 
 Elise Gan, DITV Sports Director (35-19): Utah – Most impressed I’ve been with the Utes in a long time.  
 John Bohnenkamp, Sports Writing Coach (37-17): Utah – Utes stay one of the last unbeatens. 
 Jason Brummond, Publisher (37-17): Utah – Utes look destined for a perfect regular season. 
 No. 13 Wake Forest @ SMU 
 Jackson Miller, Sports Editor (32-22): Wake Forest – It’s time to WAKE up! 
 Jonah Frey, Assistant Sports Editor (35-19): SMU – Kevin Jennings prove-it game. 
 Samantha DeFily, Creative Director (39-16): Wake Forest – Justice for Ahmaad Moses. 
 Collin Carrithers, DITV Sports Director (39-16): Wake Forest – Methodists seeing a Demon Deacon will give them nightmares. 
 Elise Gan, DITV Sports Director (35-19): Wake Forest – Demon Deacons are on a roll! 
 John Bohnenkamp, Sports Writing Coach (37-17): Wake Forest – Demon Deacons’ lone loss is to Miami. 
 Jason Brummond, Publisher (37-17): SMU – Get Wake off the CFP board. 
 No. 12 Texas Tech @ No. 25 Oklahoma State 
 Jackson Miller, Sports Editor (32-22): Oklahoma State – Drew Mestemaker is the truth. 
 Jonah Frey, Assistant Sports Editor (35-19): Oklahoma State – Drew “Mest-Fest” Mestemaker. 
 Samantha DeFily, Creative Director (39-16): Oklahoma State – Now, no shouting at children this time. 
 Collin Carrithers, DITV Sports Director (39-16): Texas Tech – This conference gives me a migraine. 
 Elise Gan, DITV Sports Director (35-19): Texas Tech – Another over/under of 100 incoming in the Big 12! 
 John Bohnenkamp, Sports Writing Coach (37-17): Oklahoma State – Not sure how the Cowboys lost to Iowa State, but… 
 Jason Brummond, Publisher (37-17): Texas Tech – Hard to pick a team that can’t even beat Ames.
